# Weyland-Yutani
[bold]Weyland-Yutani[/bold], known as "the Company", is the dominant megacorporation in human space. It was born from the merger of the British Weyland Corp and the Japanese Yutani Corporation, and led humanity's first terraforming of the Moon. Its slogan is "Building Better Worlds."
The Company makes almost everything: weapons, synthetic humans, spaceships, computers, terraforming equipment and household goods, along with shipping and other ventures. It funds and runs colonies across the frontier, and its interests don't always line up with the governments around it. Rumors persist of research it keeps hidden even from its partners.
## Forces - [bold]Weyland-Yutani PMC[/bold], the "Whiteshields": the Company's organized security force. Usually kept for Weyland-Yutani facilities, security and containment, but colonial governments often hire them because they get the job done faster than the local military.
